mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate below 5.0% signals robust labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE drops below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.2% and UNRATE below 5.0% indicates coordinated monetary and labor market easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations for positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS < 0.2% and UNRATE < 5.0% fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal sustained consumer demand for residential construction, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST rises.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates immediate consumer demand for residential construction, typically generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 240 (indicating sustained inflationary pressure) triggers expectations of monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations for negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 240.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO > 105) and housing starts (HOUST > 1200) signals robust aggregate supply-demand balance, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO > 105 and HOUST > 1200 fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high-labor-market-slack regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), rising payrolls (PAYEMS) signal improving labor conditions that boost consumer spending, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In high-labor-market-slack regimes, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises.
